name: The Temple of Itza Chihken
author: Mantichore_1
description: Congratulations adventurer, you have made it through the jungle of Egguazú and have found the hidden entrace to a temple! The only question is... are you brave enough to enter? My entry for the LEGO Ideas contest. The game might lag a bit at some points, but it's playable :) My LEGO ideas username is Mantichore (LEGO name: HonorableTrickyGamer)
